scenarios.title: Tauri iOS build installs and launches offline on a physical iPhone
scenarios.pass: All four checks true on a physical iPhone. Record Tauri, plugin, Xcode, iOS versions in the evidence notes.

scenarios.title: Notification permission states are reported correctly and the ledger stays usable
scenarios.pass: All checks true across not-determined, granted, denied, and re-enabled-in-Settings.

scenarios.title: One-shot delivery, app backgrounded, screen locked
scenarios.pass: At least 19 of 20 trials observed within 5 minutes after target (5 s early tolerance), zero duplicate, zero stale.

scenarios.title: One-shot delivery after the user force-quits the app
scenarios.pass: At least 19 of 20 trials observed within 5 minutes after target, zero duplicate, zero stale.

scenarios.title: Daily wall-clock request delivery (calendar trigger) on 20 consecutive occurrences
scenarios.pass: At least 19 of 20 occurrences observed within 5 minutes after the local target, zero duplicate, zero stale. Simulated clock days are allowed only if flagged in notes.

scenarios.title: Schedule edit with an old request pending: cancel and replace
scenarios.pass: Old request gone from the pending list, expected IDs present, zero stale and zero duplicate deliveries.

scenarios.title: Reboot with pending requests
scenarios.pass: Pending requests survive, deliver within 5 minutes, and reconcile adds no duplicates.

scenarios.title: Time-zone change while the app is closed: trigger behavior and reconciliation
scenarios.pass: Behavior of both trigger types is recorded and, after reconcile on next launch, there are no stale or duplicate requests and no past snapshot changed.

scenarios.title: Manual clock jump with an elapsed-time trigger pending
scenarios.pass: Plugin 'at' schedules map to elapsed-time triggers in source; the recorded fire time shows whether a clock jump moves them, and the app reconciles without rewriting history.

scenarios.title: Pending-request capacity
scenarios.pass: Measured capacity recorded; the app's rolling-window cap is not above it. Apple docs fetched do not state a cap.

scenarios.title: Tap, dismiss, and action never write a dose
scenarios.pass: Ledger dose-event count and occurrence status are unchanged after every interaction.

scenarios.title: Lock-screen privacy with generic text
scenarios.pass: No medication name, dose, or condition is visible on the locked screen under default and Show Previews settings.

scenarios.title: Tauri Android build installs and launches offline on a physical phone
scenarios.pass: All checks true on two phones from different manufacturers. Record merged-manifest permissions.

scenarios.title: POST_NOTIFICATIONS and channel states reported; ledger stays usable
scenarios.pass: All checks true on API 33+ devices.

scenarios.title: Exact-alarm access NOT granted: delivery with screen off
scenarios.pass: Informational: measures the weaker path the plugin falls back to. Passing is not required; the result decides whether reminders are labeled approximate or omitted.

scenarios.title: Exact-alarm access granted, allowWhileIdle on: delivery with screen off
scenarios.pass: At least 19 of 20 trials within 5 minutes after target, zero duplicate, zero stale, on each device.

scenarios.title: Forced Doze idle: delivery
scenarios.pass: Same threshold with `adb shell dumpsys deviceidle force-idle` active.

scenarios.title: App swiped from recents: delivery
scenarios.pass: Same threshold with the app task removed from recents (not Force stop).

scenarios.title: Force stop cancels alarms; app detects and rebuilds on next launch
scenarios.pass: Plugin pending() reads its own storage, so detection must be verified against `dumpsys alarm`, not pending().

scenarios.title: Reboot: restore of future requests, behavior for past-due requests
scenarios.pass: Future requests deliver, no dose is written by restore, no duplicates. Past-due behavior (source: re-fired about 15 s after boot) is recorded for a product decision.

scenarios.title: Time-zone change and manual clock change while the app is closed
scenarios.pass: After reconcile on next launch there are no stale or duplicate requests and no past snapshot changed.

scenarios.title: Exact-alarm access revoked while requests are pending
scenarios.pass: Android docs say revocation cancels future exact alarms; the app must notice and say so.

scenarios.title: Schedule edit with an old request pending: cancel and replace
scenarios.pass: Old alarm absent from `dumpsys alarm`, zero stale and zero duplicate deliveries.

scenarios.title: Tap, dismiss, and action never write a dose
scenarios.pass: Ledger dose-event count and occurrence status are unchanged after every interaction.

scenarios.title: Lock-screen privacy with generic text
scenarios.pass: No medication name, dose, or condition is visible on the locked screen.

scenarios.title: Restricted battery mode and OEM background limits: delivery
scenarios.pass: Informational: determines which user-facing battery guidance, if any, is needed.

scenarios.title: Concurrent alarm capacity
scenarios.pass: Measured capacity recorded; the app's rolling-window cap is not above it.

scenarios.title: Installed Windows build shows correct app identity for an immediate toast
scenarios.pass: Docs say the plugin shows PowerShell name and icon in development and only works for installed apps.

scenarios.title: Plugin schedule on desktop is immediate, not scheduled
scenarios.pass: Confirms the app must not route desktop reminders through the plugin schedule option.

scenarios.title: Native scheduled toast with the app process not running
scenarios.pass: At least 19 of 20 trials within 5 minutes with the app process confirmed not running at fire time. Record whether the app has package identity.

scenarios.title: Computer off or asleep beyond the 5-minute window
scenarios.pass: Microsoft docs say the toast is dropped; the app must say reminders may not have shown, never that a dose was missed.

scenarios.title: Restart with scheduled toasts pending
scenarios.pass: Survival across restart is not established by the docs fetched; record it.

scenarios.title: Schedule edit, time-zone change, and clock change
scenarios.pass: No stale or duplicate toasts after reconcile.

scenarios.title: Notification settings and Focus: suppression is detected or documented
scenarios.pass: Informational.

scenarios.title: Signed macOS bundle shows correct app identity for an immediate notification
scenarios.pass: Plugin source sets a different application identity when running in development.

scenarios.title: Plugin schedule on desktop is immediate, not scheduled
scenarios.pass: Confirms the app must not route desktop reminders through the plugin schedule option.

scenarios.title: Native UNUserNotificationCenter request with the app quit
scenarios.pass: At least 19 of 20 trials within 5 minutes with the app process confirmed not running.

scenarios.title: Sleep, wake, and lid-closed delivery
scenarios.pass: Behavior recorded and the app never reports a dose as missed.

scenarios.title: Restart with requests pending
scenarios.pass: Survival across restart is recorded; no duplicates after reconcile.

scenarios.title: Schedule edit, time-zone change, and clock change
scenarios.pass: No stale or duplicate requests after reconcile.

scenarios.title: Permission states and Focus
scenarios.pass: All checks true.

scenarios.pass: Zero mismatches over at least 200 sampled instants including transitions; otherwise record the zones and versions.

scenarios.title: Zone change detected while running, after background, and on cold start

scenarios.pass: Every sample zone resolves; legacy aliases resolve or are mapped.

scenarios.title: OS offsets agree with the bundled tzdb at sampled instants
scenarios.pass: Zero mismatches over at least 200 sampled instants including transitions; otherwise record the zones and versions.

scenarios.title: Zone change detected while running, after background, and on cold start
scenarios.pass: All checks true.

scenarios.title: Zone change detected while running and after launch
scenarios.pass: All checks true. The mechanism for zone (not clock) change events is not established by the docs fetched.

scenarios.title: Zone change detected while running and after launch
scenarios.pass: All checks true.

scenarios.title: HealthKit availability and authorization states shown without inventing data
scenarios.pass: Apple docs say a denial is indistinguishable from no data; the app must show unknown, never 'none taken'.

scenarios.title: Imported medication dose claims are labeled external and change nothing
scenarios.pass: Requires iOS 26+ with Health Medications data. Ledger and occurrence status are unchanged by any import.

scenarios.title: Write attempt of a medication dose to HealthKit by a third-party app
scenarios.pass: The pages fetched do not establish third-party write support; record the OS result. No write feature is planned.

scenarios.title: Revoked authorization, deleted source data, locked device
scenarios.pass: No crash, no inferred doses, imported items flagged unavailable.

scenarios.title: Health Connect availability states handled
scenarios.pass: All states handled without crash; ledger unaffected.

scenarios.title: Health Connect permission denied or revoked while running
scenarios.pass: Missing permission is shown as unknown, never as no doses.

scenarios.title: Health Connect Medical Records medication resources read as external claims
scenarios.pass: Experimental API. A medication statement is a reported medication, not evidence of intake.
